capabilities.description: bin entry, shebang, executable bit, and installed shim
the shared WorkflowEngine client is dependency-free ESM with a stable export surface
every documented command is registered and dispatched, never reported as unknown
only the instance owner token is accepted; 401 and 403 map to exit 3
credentials persist atomically at 0600 and never appear in output
chat consumes SSE deltas over a real socket
work posts to the native Work route and consumes cumulative snapshots and final text
a Work stream that ends without a final frame fails instead of reporting success
an aborted run stops streaming and exits 130
documented exit codes 0-6 and 130 are produced for their conditions
required operations and a supported API version are enforced before CI passes
byte-reproducible release tarballs, checksums, and extracted content verification
no runtime dependencies, no install scripts, no stale or vulnerable lockfile
the installed CLI has no local inference, database, daemon, Docker or Ollama surface

capabilities.reason: The CLI has no replay cursor or resume command. The harness implements SSE id replay so a future client change can be verified, but the CLI makes no claim to support it.
The CLI does not reconnect a dropped stream; it fails with exit 4 rather than silently resuming.
There is no CLI command or flag to resume an interrupted Work run.
pending_action frames are tolerated but not surfaced or approved by the CLI; no approval workflow exists to verify.
The CLI does not persist or reopen conversations, so continuity can only be verified in the deployment's clients, not here.
